query:
UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "CBD", "percentage": 15.0, "role": "Cannabinoïde principal"}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "percentage": 0.8, "role": "Terpène dominant"}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "percentage": 0.5, "role": "Terpène secondaire"}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "percentage": 0.3, "role": "Terpène aromatique"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "CBD", "minPercent": 12.0, "maxPercent": 18.0, "typical": 15.0}, {"molecule": "THC", "minPercent": 0.1, "maxPercent": 0.5, "typical": 0.3}, {"molecule": "CBG", "minPercent": 0.3, "maxPercent": 0.8, "typical": 0.5}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "minPercent": 0.5, "maxPercent": 1.2, "typical": 0.8}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes terreuses et herbacées avec des touches de pin et de citron. Profil aromatique doux et équilibré.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Citron", "Pin"], "heart": ["Herbe", "Terre"], "base": ["Bois", "Musc"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-CBD-X01';

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "percentage": 1.2, "role": "Terpène dominant"}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "percentage": 0.6, "role": "Terpène aromatique"}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "percentage": 0.4, "role": "Terpène sédatif"}, {"molecule": "Humulène", "percentage": 0.3, "role": "Terpène épicé"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "THC", "minPercent": 15.0, "maxPercent": 22.0, "typical": 18.0}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "minPercent": 0.8, "maxPercent": 1.5, "typical": 1.2}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "minPercent": 0.4, "maxPercent": 0.9, "typical": 0.6}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes poivrées et épicées distinctives avec des touches florales et fruitées. Arôme colombien caractéristique.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Poivre rose", "Agrumes"], "heart": ["Floral", "Épices"], "base": ["Bois", "Terre"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-CAN-X02';

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Myrcène", "percentage": 1.0, "role": "Terpène dominant"}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "percentage": 0.5, "role": "Terpène épicé"}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "percentage": 0.4, "role": "Terpène fruité"}, {"molecule": "α-Pinène", "percentage": 0.2, "role": "Terpène frais"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "THC", "minPercent": 20.0, "maxPercent": 26.0, "typical": 23.0}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "minPercent": 0.7, "maxPercent": 1.3, "typical": 1.0}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "minPercent": 0.3, "maxPercent": 0.7, "typical": 0.5}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Arômes de cerise et de baies avec des notes terreuses et sucrées. Profil fruité et gourmand.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Cerise", "Baies"], "heart": ["Sucré", "Fruité"], "base": ["Terre", "Bois"]}'

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Limonène", "percentage": 0.8, "role": "Terpène dominant"}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "percentage": 0.6, "role": "Terpène épicé"}, {"molecule": "α-Pinène", "percentage": 0.4, "role": "Terpène frais"}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "percentage": 0.3, "role": "Terpène sédatif"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "THC", "minPercent": 14.0, "maxPercent": 19.0, "typical": 16.0}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "minPercent": 0.5, "maxPercent": 1.1, "typical": 0.8}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "minPercent": 0.4, "maxPercent": 0.8, "typical": 0.6}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes épicées et herbeuses caractéristiques de la Jamaïque. Arôme frais et énergisant.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Citron", "Herbe fraîche"], "heart": ["Épices", "Pin"], "base": ["Terre", "Encens"]}'

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Limonène", "percentage": 0.9, "role": "Terpène dominant"}, {"molecule": "α-Pinène", "percentage": 0.5, "role": "Terpène frais"}, {"molecule": "β-Caryophyllène", "percentage": 0.4, "role": "Terpène épicé"}, {"molecule": "Myrcène", "percentage": 0.3, "role": "Terpène sédatif"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "THC", "minPercent": 12.0, "maxPercent": 17.0, "typical": 14.0}, {"molecule": "Limonène", "minPercent": 0.6, "maxPercent": 1.2, "typical": 0.9}, {"molecule": "α-Pinène", "minPercent": 0.3, "maxPercent": 0.7, "typical": 0.5}]',

  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Fruits tropicaux", "Agrumes"], "heart": ["Épices", "Floral"], "base": ["Terre rouge", "Bois"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-CAN-X05';
